1001.Name: Cloud of Tempest
1001.ShortDescription: A thundercloud is summoned on the enemy side of the battlefield, striking random enemy heroes every #.SArg3#s and dealing damage for #.SArg4.Per# of the target's max health, up to #.SArg0.Per# of the Attack Rating of the allied hero with the highest Attack Rating. When an allied hero deals damage with their Normal Attack, they trigger a "Lightning Chain", draining health from the #.SArg1# enemy nearest to the target equal to #.SArg2.Per# of the Normal Attack damage. This effect can only be triggered once every #.SArg5#s by each allied hero.
1001.LongDescription: A thundercloud is summoned on the enemy side of the battlefield, striking random enemy heroes every #.SArg3#s and dealing damage for #.SArg4.Per# of the target's max health, up to #.SArg0.Per# of the Attack Rating of the allied hero with the highest Attack Rating. When an allied hero deals damage with their Normal Attack, they trigger a "Lightning Chain", draining health from the #.SArg1# enemy nearest to the target equal to #.SArg2.Per# of the Normal Attack damage. This effect can only be triggered once every #.SArg5#s by each allied hero.

1011.Name: Meteoric Rise
1011.ShortDescription: When an allied hero uses their Ultimate skill, they summon an additional #.SArg0# meteor, dealing magic damage for #.PlusRatio.Per# of their own Attack Rating to random enemy heroes. If the Ultimate skill is used not more than #.SArg1#s after the last time an allied hero used their Ultimate skill, the number of meteors summoned this time will be increased by #.SArg2#, with its maximum limit being #.SArg3#. This effect can only be triggered once every #.SArg4#s by each hero.
1011.LongDescription: When an allied hero uses their Ultimate skill, they summon an additional #.SArg0# meteor, dealing magic damage for #.PlusRatio.Per# of their own Attack Rating to random enemy heroes. If the Ultimate skill is used not more than #.SArg1#s after the last time an allied hero used their Ultimate skill, the number of meteors summoned this time will be increased by #.SArg2#, with its maximum limit being #.SArg3#. This effect can only be triggered once every #.SArg4#s by each hero.

1021.Name: Boulder Armor
1021.ShortDescription: When an allied hero is protected by a shield, the damage they receive is reduced by #.SArg0.Per#. When they take damage, a boulder is summoned that deals magic damage for #.SArg1.Per# of their shield value to the attacker, up to #.SArg2.Per# of their Attack Rating. This effect can only be triggered once every #.SArg3#s by each allied hero.
1021.LongDescription: When an allied hero is protected by a shield, the damage they receive is reduced by #.SArg0.Per#. When they take damage, a boulder is summoned that deals magic damage for #.SArg1.Per# of their shield value to the attacker, up to #.SArg2.Per# of their Attack Rating. This effect can only be triggered once every #.SArg3#s by each allied hero.

1031.Name: Dagger of Disaster
1031.ShortDescription: When the wielder deals damage to an enemy hero that is facing away from them, the enemy target is inflicted with the "Catastrophic" effect. After #.SArg0#s, the enemy receives damage for #.PlusRatio.Per# of their Attack Rating. This damage has a 100% critical strike chance. This effect can only be triggered once every #.SArg1#s by each allied hero.
1031.LongDescription: When the wielder deals damage to an enemy hero that is facing away from them, the enemy target is inflicted with the "Catastrophic" effect. After #.SArg0#s, the enemy receives damage for #.PlusRatio.Per# of their Attack Rating. This damage has a 100% critical strike chance. This effect can only be triggered once every #.SArg1#s by each allied hero.

1041.Name: Sweeping Tide
1041.ShortDescription: When an allied hero attacks, the damage dealt is increased based on the target's distance from them, by up to #.SArg0.Per#. Meanwhile, a turbulent wave appears every #.SArg2#s targeting the #.SArg1# enemy closest to the allied side, dealing damage for #.PlusRatio.Per# of the wielder's Attack Rating to enemies along the way and knocking them back.
1041.LongDescription: When an allied hero attacks, the damage dealt is increased based on the target's distance from them, by up to #.SArg0.Per#. Meanwhile, a turbulent wave appears every #.SArg2#s targeting the #.SArg1# enemy closest to the allied side, dealing damage for #.PlusRatio.Per# of the wielder's Attack Rating to enemies along the way and knocking them back.

1051.Name: Axe of Fury
1051.ShortDescription: After an allied hero uses their Ultimate, the Energy consumed the next time they use their Ultimate is reduced by #.SArg1# points, up to #.SArg3# points. After the start of battle, damage dealt by the allied hero is increased by #.SArg4.Per# for #.SArg5#s. Meanwhile, when an allied hero uses their Ultimate skill, they fire an additional arrow targeting the enemy with the lowest health, dealing damage equal to #.PlusRatio.Per# of their Attack Rating to all enemies along the way. This effect can only be triggered once every #.SArg2#s by each hero.
1051.LongDescription: After an allied hero uses their Ultimate, the Energy consumed the next time they use their Ultimate is reduced by #.SArg1# points, up to #.SArg3# points. After the start of battle, damage dealt by the allied hero is increased by #.SArg4.Per# for #.SArg5#s. Meanwhile, when an allied hero uses their Ultimate skill, they fire an additional arrow targeting the enemy with the lowest health, dealing damage equal to #.PlusRatio.Per# of their Attack Rating to all enemies along the way. This effect can only be triggered once every #.SArg2#s by each hero.

1061.Name: Frosty Trap
1061.ShortDescription: After an allied hero has dealt control effects to enemies #.SArg0# times, they summon a giant snowball in the area most concentrated with enemies, dealing damage equal to #.PlusRatio.Per# of the wielder's Attack Rating to enemies within range and freezing them for #.SArg1#s. If the enemy is being controlled, the damage dealt this time is increased by #.SArg2.Per#. This effect can only trigger once every #.SArg3#s.
1061.LongDescription: After an allied hero has dealt control effects to enemies #.SArg0# times, they summon a giant snowball in the area most concentrated with enemies, dealing damage equal to #.PlusRatio.Per# of the wielder's Attack Rating to enemies within range and freezing them for #.SArg1#s. If the enemy is being controlled, the damage dealt this time is increased by #.SArg2.Per#. This effect can only trigger once every #.SArg3#s.

1071.Name: Ring of Dominion
1071.ShortDescription: When an allied hero deals damage to an enemy target, they hit the target with a heavy blow, dealing physical damage for #.PlusRatio.Per# of the allied hero's Attack Rating. If the allied hero has a summoned unit on the battlefield, the heavy blow deals additional physical damage for #.SArg0.Per# of the summoned unit's Attack Rating and also summons a guard that inherits #.SArg1.Per# of the allied hero's attributes. The guard can exist for up to #.SArg2#s and can knock enemies airborne. This effect can only trigger once every #.SArg3#s. Up to #.SArg4# guards can exist at a time.
1071.LongDescription: When an allied hero deals damage to an enemy target, they hit the target with a heavy blow, dealing physical damage for #.PlusRatio.Per# of the allied hero's Attack Rating. If the allied hero has a summoned unit on the battlefield, the heavy blow deals additional physical damage for #.SArg0.Per# of the summoned unit's Attack Rating and also summons a guard that inherits #.SArg1.Per# of the allied hero's attributes. The guard can exist for up to #.SArg2#s and can knock enemies airborne. This effect can only trigger once every #.SArg3#s. Up to #.SArg4# guards can exist at a time.
